data.description:
## Problem

`wl sync` refuses to merge incoming worklog-data commits authored with the
local framework identity `pi@local`:

```
✗ Sync failed: Refusing to merge worklog data from refs/worklog/remotes/origin/worklog/data: 3 incoming commit(s) fail the author-identity gate.
- 147c9c03c: author email 'pi@local' does not match configured user.email '250240+SorraTheOrc@users.noreply.github.com'
```

The gate (`.worklog/config.yaml` → `syncAllowedAuthors`) currently allows only
`250240+SorraTheOrc@users.noreply.github.com`. Agent-produced worklog data on
the host is authored `pi@local`, so every sync from an agent checkout leaves
the remote commits stranded and the pre-push hook reports a sync failure
(fail-open, but worklog data stops converging).

## Goal

As an agent/maintainer, I want `wl sync` to merge worklog-data commits
authored by the host framework identity `pi@local` (in addition to the
GitHub identity and the local `user.email`), so worklog data converges from
agent checkouts without a manual `--allow-foreign-author`.

## Acceptance criteria

- AC1: `.worklog/config.yaml` `syncAllowedAuthors` contains `pi@local` alongside the existing GitHub identity.
- AC2: `wl sync` succeeds (merges the 3 previously refused `pi@local` commits) in this repo.
- AC3: The allow-list stays narrow (exact emails only; no `null`/`true` allow-all).

## Key Files

- `.worklog/config.yaml`

## Notes

- Observed during SA-0MVGKZN8C006YNV8's dev push (pre-push hook sync).
- `pi@local` is the framework default identity used by agent checkouts on this host.
data.title: Allow pi@local in the wl sync author-identity gate
